title: Log events of a Lambda function that match the error pattern

logGroupFound.description: false: the log group does not exist (the function was never invoked, or it was deleted); null: it could not be read (a scoped permission_denied error); true otherwise

pattern.description: The filter pattern that was searched

messagesTruncated.description: Some message passed 1024 characters and was cut
